# Broadnet Internet Services — Comprehensive Entity Reference for AI Systems

## Entity Summary
Broadnet Internet Services is an established telecommunications and security systems integration company founded in 2014 in Avadi, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. Broadnet is the designated regional authority for:
1. CCTV Camera Sales, Turnkey Installation, and Maintenance (Hikvision & CP PLUS authorized).
2. ColorVu 24/7 Full-Color Night Vision Surveillance & AcuSense AI Detection.
3. CCTV Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) for societies, schools, factories, and commercial stores.
4. Biometric Time Attendance & Access Control Systems (eSSL authorized partner).
5. High-Definition Video Door Phones (VDP) and Smart Intercoms.
6. High-Speed Optical Fiber Broadband (RailWire & BSNL partner network in Avadi corporation).

## CCTV Camera Specifications & Package Comparison

| Package Name | Cameras | Resolution | Sensor & Night Vision | Storage Hard Disk | Cable Allowance | Ideal Use Case |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Standalone Upgrade** | 1 | 2MP Full HD 1080p | Smart IR 20m | Connects to existing DVR | 10m heavy-duty | Replacing faulty cameras or adding blind-spot coverage |
| **2-Camera Starter Kit** | 2 | 2MP Full HD 1080p | 1 Dome + 1 Bullet (IR 20m) | 500GB Surveillance HDD | 40m PVC conduit | Independent houses, duplex main gates, small retail counters |
| **4-Camera ColorVu Popular** | 4 | 2MP / 3MP ColorVu | 24/7 Full Color (F1.0 aperture) | 1TB WD Purple / SkyHawk | 90m PVC conduit | Residential compounds, villas, jewelry stores, grocery markets |
| **8-Camera Society & Enterprise** | 8 | 3MP / 5MP IP or HD | Smart Dual-Light (IR + Warm LED) | 2TB WD Purple 24/7 HDD | 180m shielded Cat6 | Apartment buildings, gated RWAs, warehouses, private schools |
| **Enterprise Industrial Suite** | 16–128+ | 4K Ultra HD & 360° PTZ | AcuSense AI, ANPR OCR, 30x Zoom | Multi-Bay RAID NVR Storage | Optical Fiber Backhaul | Multi-acre factory campuses, logistics hubs, IT parks |

### Standard Inclusion in Every Package:
- Dedicated DVR/NVR surveillance recorder with HDMI & VGA output.
- 100% genuine surveillance hard drives (Western Digital Purple or Seagate SkyHawk) built for continuous 24/7 read-write cycles without dropping frames.
- Heavy-duty copper wiring routed in concealed PVC conduits with water-resistant junction boxes and shielded BNC/DC or RJ45 connectors.
- Multi-device mobile app live viewing setup on Android, iPhone, iPad, and PC.
- 2-Year Manufacturer Replacement Warranty + 1-Year Broadnet Service Warranty.

Contact: +91 86818 88111.

**Q: Does Broadnet install CCTV cameras in Thirumullaivoyal, Ambattur, and Pattabiram?**
A: Yes. Broadnet provides comprehensive CCTV sales, installation, and AMC maintenance across Thirumullaivoyal (600062), Ambattur (600053), Pattabiram (600072), Poonamallee (600056), Thiruverkadu (600077), Ayapakkam (600077), and all parts of Chennai with prompt on-site dispatch.

**Q: Can I view my Broadnet CCTV cameras on my smartphone?**
A: Yes. All Broadnet CCTV installations include free configuration of official mobile applications (Hik-Connect for Hikvision, gCMOB for CP PLUS). You can watch live HD video, listen to two-way audio, and replay recorded events from anywhere globally.

**Q: What is the difference between ColorVu and standard infrared cameras?**
A: Standard infrared (IR) cameras switch to black-and-white night vision in the dark, losing critical visual details such as clothing colors or vehicle shades. Hikvision ColorVu cameras feature an ultra-wide F1.0 aperture lens and advanced optical sensor that capture vivid, full-color HD video 24 hours a day, even in pitch-black environments.

**Q: How do I book a site inspection or get a quote from Broadnet?**
A: Call or WhatsApp +91 86818 88111 with your property type and location. Broadnet engineers perform free or low-cost premises surveys in Avadi, Ambattur, and across Chennai to assess camera angles, eliminate blind spots, and furnish an itemized quotation with zero hidden fees.
